brief: Rho reads a formula as a surface: the slope at a dot, the walk downhill and a formula through three dots.

title.pt-BR: Inclinações a partir de uma fórmula

regional.universal: One neutral board: numbers and shapes only, and any amount is written with each market's own currency sign.
